title: Northgate Protect Standard Plans: Cancellation Refund Outside the Full-Refund Window
content:
**Refund clause.** On a Northgate Protect Standard 2-Year or Standard 3-Year plan canceled at the plan holder's request outside the full-refund window, the Standard plan's cancellation date is today, and the Standard plan's price kept is its one-time charges less any refunds already booked on it. The Standard plan cancellation refund is the Standard plan's price kept times its unused share, which is its unused coverage days divided by its coverage days, where the coverage days run from the coverage start date through the day before the coverage end date and the unused coverage days run from the day after the cancellation date through the day before the coverage end date, never more than the coverage days, less a cancellation fee equal to the lesser of the tier's cancellation fee percentage of the price kept and the tier's cancellation fee cap, never below zero and never more than the price kept, rounded down to the cent.

**Order of assembly.** The unused share and the cancellation fee are settled first; the refund is then figured with them as the refund clause states; every amount that comes off or is added is applied next and the result is never below zero; a rate that raises the refund is applied after that; and the refund is held to no more than the price kept and rounded down to the cent once at the end.

## Worked example on hypothetical figures

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Price kept | $120.00 |
| Coverage days | 1095 |
| Unused coverage days | 730 |
| Unused share | 730 divided by 1095, two thirds |
| Price kept times the unused share | $80.00 |
| Cancellation fee: the lesser of 10 percent of $120.00 and $25.00 | $12.00 |
| Refund, rounded down to the cent | $68.00 |

## Points of judgement

- Unused coverage days stop at zero once the cancellation date reaches the day before the coverage end date.
- Rounding is down to the cent, once, after everything else: a hypothetical figure of $41.379 is refunded as $41.37.
